tasks.short: Assign and review music staff work

steps.what: Assign scoring, arranging, copying, or vocal coaching work to appropriate staff
Review staff work and discuss musical or coaching corrections

tasks.design: Retain assignment and musical review with the director. Existing {PROJECT} assignments and work in {DOCS} support the process without automated staff ranking or artistic evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff suitability and musical quality cannot be established from task completion fields.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation of assignment or substantive review is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Matching work to capabilities and giving useful musical feedback.
tasks.human_edge: The director understands the artistic aim and can help a staff member improve the result.
tasks.altitude: Staff direction and review responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Music staff assignment and substantive review remain human judgement; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is director assignment and review, excluding staff execution. Staff produce work products after s1 and before s2 through unchanged work; they are not assumed available at assignment.
Director supplies requirements and staff knowledge during s1. No new structured performance score, extraction, or staff monitoring is introduced.
Native project and document tools remain sufficient; unchanged process adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which review decisions need direct musical discussion rather than status tracking?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero. Assignment and substantive review stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study films and scripts for musical possibilities

steps.what: Study films or scripts to determine how music could create desired effects or moods

tasks.design: Retain close script and picture study using {DOCS} and the film-playback application {OTHER}. The composer develops musical possibilities from the actual dramatic material rather than treating a summary as equivalent study.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plot summary can omit timing, subtext, or ambiguity that matters musically.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement of close creative study is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing how music could alter a scene's meaning without overwhelming it.
tasks.human_edge: The composer interprets dramatic nuance and imagines a musical response.
tasks.altitude: Creative study remains the composer's responsibility.

reach.task: Explain a musical interpretation of a scene

evidence.claim: Creative study of films and scripts remains human interpretation; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary covers the composer's own study, excluding the separate discussion with producers and directors and subsequent cue composition. OTHER is film-playback software.
Producer or editor supplies the existing current script and picture before study. No structured mood feed or automated scene interpretation is required.
Native document and playback tools remain sufficient; unchanged practice adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which musically important details are lost in a summary of the sequence?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero because close dramatic study remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Adapt compositions and melodic lines for a group or style

steps.what: Study the composition and establish the group's capabilities and intended musical style
Choose the adaptation's musical changes and exact part transpositions
Transcribe the chosen notes and exact transpositions into the adapted parts
Check the adapted parts for musical character, range, spelling, and playability

tasks.design: Use native copy and exact transposition functions in the notation application {OTHER} after the composer chooses the musical adaptation. Keep stylistic changes, range choices, and playability review human; no model invents an arrangement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Part preparation can repeat notes and transpositions already chosen by the composer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native notation functions can apply exact transformations to specified passages.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving musical identity while fitting the group's abilities and the requested style.
tasks.human_edge: The composer knows when literal transposition produces an awkward or unconvincing part.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical part entry; arranging decisions stay with the composer.

evidence.claim: Native notation copying and exact transposition can reduce mechanical part preparation after musical decisions are made; this is an E1 design estimate.

assumptions: Boundary covers adaptation of an existing composition for a group or style, excluding transcription of a newly imagined idea and original composition. OTHER is the notation application.

Composer produces the symbolic notes and part specification in s2: source version, passage boundaries, target part, interval, octave, key signature, and spelling preference. Capture and musical selection remain in s2. Unstructured, incomplete, or ambiguous passages are entered manually.
Test native copy and transpose before custom code. Savings require actual repeated note entry today; existing automatic transposition runtime receives no saving. No music is released automatically.
research_questions: Does exact native part preparation reduce active effort after specification and musical correction are counted?

already_counted.description: Check the adaptation's musical and practical suitability

incremental.description: Maintain transformation presets and verify part mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 5 upkeep gives net 15. Range assumes symbolic source material and repeated manual part entry; already automated preparation may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create original musical forms or compose within established forms

steps.what: Create original musical forms or write within forms such as sonatas, symphonies, or operas

tasks.design: Retain original composition and formal development in the composition application {OTHER}. Existing notation and playback support the work without deciding its musical form or expressive value.
tasks.previous_blocker: Following a formal pattern does not establish a convincing original composition.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported automation of original musical form is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Creating coherent development, contrast, and resolution over the whole work.
tasks.human_edge: The composer judges which formal choices make the music worth hearing.

reach.task: Discuss how the composition's form shapes rehearsal and performance

evidence.claim: Original formal composition is retained as artistic work; no saving is assumed from notation transcription capability.

assumptions: Boundary is large-scale original composition, excluding mechanical notation, orchestral completion, and motif discovery assigned to separate tasks. OTHER is the composition application; overlapping creative labour is counted once in roll-up.
Composer develops the structure during s1 from existing themes and intent. No complete structured composition brief or automated artistic-quality flag is presumed.
Native notation and playback tools remain sufficient; current runtime earns no new saving and unchanged practice adds zero upkeep.
research_questions: Which activities are musical development itself rather than mechanical score entry?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero because original formal composition stays unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The director and composer retain staff, dramatic, and musical judgement while using exact notation functions for already chosen part transformations.
role.ambitious_version: A musician who keeps creative decisions personal and prepares adapted parts with fewer mechanical repetitions.
